core_obligations: Take W' inside W inside U as in lemma-finite-flat-over-almost-dense-subscheme; by its addendum each u_j lies in W and W' to W is a thickening of finite presentation (proof lines 2816-2819). By limits-lemma-affines-glued-in-closed-affine it suffices to find an R-invariant affine open V' of W' containing the orbit points, since the corresponding open V of W will be affine; hence replace (U, R, s, t, c) by the restriction (W', R', s', t', c'), so that s and t are finite locally free (proof lines 2820-2827). By properties-lemma-maximal-points-affine one finds an affine open containing the union of the orbits of u_1, ..., u_m; applying groupoids-lemma-find-invariant-affine to this data produces the R-invariant affine open and concludes the proof (proof lines 2828-2832).
proof_roadmap: Pull the orbit points into W via the addendum to the almost-dense lemma (proof lines 2816-2819).
Reduce to the finite locally free restriction W' via the affines-glued-in-closed-affine criterion (proof lines 2820-2827).
Find an affine open around the orbit points (maximal-points lemma) and apply the groupoids find-invariant-affine lemma (proof lines 2828-2832).
